Bill.BriefDescription: Revising penalties for intermediate driver's license violations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to intermediate drivers' licenses; and amending RCW46.20.267 and 43.131.398.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.20.267 and 2000 c 115 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a person issued an intermediate license is convicted of or foundto have committed a traffic offense described in chapter 46.61 RCW orviolated restrictions placed on an intermediate license under RCW46.20.075 or subsection (2) of this section: (1) On the first such conviction or finding, the department shallmail the parent or guardian of the person a letter warning the personof the provisions of this section; (2) On the second such conviction or finding, the ((departmentshall suspend the person's)) holder of an intermediate driver's licensemay not operate a motor vehicle except when the holder is accompaniedby a licensed driver with at least five years of driving experience whois occupying the seat beside the driver for a period of six months fromthe date of the second conviction or finding or until the person p. 1 SB 5655reaches eighteen years of age, whichever occurs first((, and)). Thedepartment must mail the parent or guardian of the person anotification of the ((suspension)) restriction; (3) On the third such conviction or finding, the department shallsuspend the person's intermediate driver's license until the personreaches eighteen years of age, and mail the parent or guardian of theperson a notification of the suspension. For the purposes of this section, a single ticket for one or moretraffic offenses constitutes a single traffic offense. It is a trafficinfraction for the holder of an intermediate license to operate a motorvehicle in violation of the restriction imposed under subsection (2) ofthis section.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.131.398 and 2000 c 115 s 13 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts, as now existing or hereafteramended, are each repealed, effective June 30, 2009: (1) 2000 c 115 s 1 (uncodified); (2) RCW 42.20.075 and 2000 c 115 s 2; (3) RCW 46.20.267 and 2007 c ... s 1 (section 1 of this act) and2000 c 115 s 3; (4) The amendment of RCW 46.20.105 by 2000 c 115 s 5; (5) The amendment of RCW 46.20.161 by 2000 c 115 s 6; (6) The amendment of RCW 46.20.311 by 2000 c 115 s 7; (7) The amendment of RCW 46.20.342 by 2000 c 115 s 8; and (8) RCW 28A.220.070 and 2000 c 115 s 11.
